STORYTIME ADVENTURE 12 · CLASS 29

Little Bear’s Big Decision

Age 4–5 YearsClass 29 · StorytimeSkill Best-choice thinking

A crying friend, a busy road, a spill — tap the best thing for Little Bear to do next.

Play the story game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · BEST-CHOICE THINKING

Little Bear’s Big Decision

Look at what happened, then tap the best thing for Little Bear to do next.

Friend is crying over a broken toy. What should Little Bear do?

The road is busy with cars. What should Little Bear do?

Oh no — the cup tipped over. What should Little Bear do?

Three good decisions!

Comfort a friend, cross with a grown-up, clean up together.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Each round pairs a small problem with a safe or kind choice and a careless one. Ask your child to say the choice out loud before tapping — saying it is the comprehension.

Prefer paper? The Little Bear’s Big Decision worksheet prints the same story with room to retell and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
